notes: לֹא + תוּכַל → *cannot* is verified indivisible under rule 35's ruling that where יָכֹל stands in the clause the two morphemes share the one word; the subject pronoun *it* stays in that unit, as in לֹא אוּכַל → *I cannot*.
The source head is placed on the verb as the morpheme carrying the modal lexeme; rule 23's negation-heads-the-fusion sentence is the competing choice and is named in the unit note under rule 8.
The italic *which* is added: the אַרְבַּע clause carries no relative morpheme (rule 55).
